description: Schema for daily weather observation CSV files (weather_daily_YYYY-MM.csv).

fields.name: date
fields.description: Calendar date of observation in ISO-8601 format.

fields.name: min_temp
fields.description: Minimum temperature recorded for the day.

fields.name: max_temp
fields.description: Maximum temperature recorded for the day.

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: One or more weather condition terms from the controlled vocabulary.
